name: Finch Pet
systemPrompt: This extension provides a desktop pet. Use pet_control for common show, hide, animation, and speech actions. If the user wants to add a pet without naming an exact one, discover and call pet_catalog from the local finch-pet MCP server first. Present the current Petdex candidates with preview images and short descriptions, ask the user to choose, and only call pet_add after confirmation. Use the candidate page URL directly and never ask the user to copy a Petdex link. Use pet_list, pet_select, and pet_remove for local library management.

pet-toggle.noPetTitle: No pet is ready to display
pet-toggle.noPetDescription: Install a desktop pet from Petdex first.
pet-toggle.chooseWithFinchDescription: Start a new chat and decide after previewing
pet-toggle.installPrompt: Help me choose a desktop pet. Call pet_catalog from the finch-pet MCP server, show current candidates with preview images and descriptions, and wait for my choice before calling pet_add. Do not ask me to copy a link.

pet.noAvailable: No pet is ready to display. Choose one from Petdex in the Finch Pet menu, or ask me to show candidates and install your choice in chat.

petCatalog.title: Choose a pet from Petdex
petCatalog.description: Current popular Petdex pets are ready. Your choice will be downloaded, installed, and shown automatically.
petCatalog.galleryDescription: Open the gallery if you want to browse more candidates.
petCatalog.invalidSelection: That pet is no longer in the current candidates. Choose again.

runtime.waitingMany: A few things are waiting for your nod
runtime.runningMany: I’m keeping an eye on a few things
